commands.result: pass: contract, canonical positive receipt and six canonical negatives

acceptance.1 two of three accepted, one vote refuse: two_of_three_delegates_accept_the_canonical_head resolves and acquires the shared tip and asserts threshold 2, three delegates, two observations; a_single_vote_never_reaches_the_threshold fails with radicle_source_canonical_quorum
acceptance.2 diverging tips refused: diverging_delegate_tips_have_no_canonical_head uses four delegates, threshold two, two tips with two votes each, and fails with a canonical quorum or object error
acceptance.3 receipt lists identity revision and vo: the accepted receipt's canonical evidence is asserted for identity commit, identity root, threshold, delegate count, reference, object, object kind and the two observations
acceptance.4 heartwood parity: the quorum is computed by the vendored heartwood implementation (Rules::from_raw, Rules::canonical, find_objects, quorum) at the reviewed revision, not reimplemented
acceptance.identity revision binding: a_delegate_with_a_different_identity_revision_is_refused re-signs one delegate's refs over a different identity document and fails with radicle_source_canonical_identity_revision
acceptance.single-signer unchanged: requests and receipts without canonical serialize without the field; the existing single-signer native, shell and contract tests pass unchanged, and fixtures/radicle-source-contract/base.ncl and positive/receipt.ncl are untouched

decisions: The identity document revision is operator-pinned; the shell reads it and requires identical embedded bytes from every observing delegate but does not verify its revision history (documented non-claim)
Delegates that published no sigrefs or omitted the reference have no vote; they do not fail the request
A missing crefs rule is replaced by a rule of all delegates at the document threshold, mirroring Radicle's default-branch rule
Canonical evidence is recomputed after acquisition; a change fails the acquisition with radicle_source_canonical_moved
trade_offs: Only branch references are admitted by the contract; canonical tags remain issue #21
A wrong or stale pinned identity revision is an operator error the receipt records but does not detect
Diverging commits surface as either the quorum or the object-resolution failure depending on heartwood's path; both refuse
not_run: live Radicle node interoperability for canonical mode (native fixtures use heartwood directly; no WAN)
